## Coverage Boundaries

### agent-skills-reference

Negative canary: SKILL.md without required description frontmatter.

- Agent Skills is a portable standards-floor reference check, not proof of any provider runtime contract.
- Internal conformance fallback: provider-specific skill metadata and runtime behavior (`packages/core/src/provider-format-conformance.ts`; `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance-coverage.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/provider-format-conformance.test.ts`).

### claude-product

Negative canary: invalid JSON in .claude-plugin/plugin.json.

- Product validation proves authoring ingestion shape, not installation, trust, activation, or runtime behavior.
- Internal conformance fallback: Skillset output ownership and provenance, render-result coverage (`packages/core/src/provider-format-conformance.ts`; `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance-coverage.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/provider-format-conformance.test.ts`).

### codex-authoring

Negative canary: missing name in .codex-plugin/plugin.json.

- The released plugin-creator script is an authoring validator, not a whole-provider or runtime-hook validator.
- Internal conformance fallback: hooks, render-result coverage, runtime consumption (`packages/core/src/provider-format-conformance.ts`; `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance-coverage.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/provider-format-conformance.test.ts`).

### cursor-authoring

Negative canary: missing name in .cursor-plugin/plugin.json.

- The provider-owned source validator is not a whole-provider runtime validator.
- The public schema and shipped Cursor Agent 2026.07.23-e383d2b disagree on category and tags placement; Skillset preserves the conflict and does not synthesize either field from keywords.
- The shipped Cursor Agent bundle is recorded as runtime-consumer evidence only (sha256:b3b9931f3817c1b269b49148be70965830811d52b2aee98b9513247675838040).
- Internal conformance fallback: category and tags authority conflict, render-result coverage, runtime consumption (`packages/core/src/provider-format-conformance.ts`; `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance-coverage.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/adapter-conformance.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/__tests__/provider-format-conformance.test.ts`).
